thread:
Alex: FYI toggled tenant:aurora -> prefer v2. Console immediately shows "Prefer: v2" but traces show many calls executing v1.
Sam: likely pinning or sticky routing. Can you paste headers for a few samples?
Alex: sample: x-rw-requested: rwd-v2 / x-rw-executed: rwd-v1 / fallback: kv-cache-mismatch
Nina: we only display config preference in the console right now. UX should show both "Config / Effective" and a short reason when different.
Beth: support reports tenants think their quota moved to v2. We should clarify billing: charge quota to requested model, infra cost to executed. Add short tooltip explaining that.
Sam: telemetry plan: add fields requested_model, executed_model, fallback_reason and a fallback_count counter. Start with 0.5% sampling on busy routes.
Alex: also add a tiny amber badge "pending effective" when config != effective for >12s so customers know it isn't instantaneous.
Nina: agree. Can we make fallback_reason an enum (kv-cache-mismatch, capacity, model-unavailable, seqlen)? helps dashboards.
Beth: I'll mock the UI and wording. Alex/Sam please link the telemetry PR.
SRE-bot: ci: patch/eng-platform/console-effective-view (PR 3344) created by sam  tests passed.
